fra.text: The Tower took shape when the Theorist took up residence in Hexhaven's bell tower, warping the campus into the tower.

The Detective told Vraska that the Theorist must be stopped and must die, and he vanished into her mind in a blue light after asking the others to hold the rest of his parts in their minds until they could be unified with the Theorist's body.

In the tower, the Theorist continued the overlay, weaving both Multiverses together while losing his memories, and he aligned his mage-rings and commanded his doppelgangers to kill anyone who tried to stop it.
Liliana tried to talk him down, and Vraska, disguised as her double, stabbed him in the heart, after which the aberrations reintegrated into one and Jace opened his eyes, whole again.
In the quiet of the sanctum, with the orrery separated overhead, Jace died in Vraska's arms, unafraid.
